name: CLI enforces explicit review identity for commit authorization
description: Rejects accept without an identity, obtains the prepared identity through ready, and commits that exact proposal.

passage.quote: The request must provide the identity of the prepared review. A missing or different identity is rejected. A successful result contains the commit identity, whether recovery was performed, and the acceptance duration; the operation requires the branch and repository state supported by the acceptance model.
Ready exposes the worktree’s saved prepared proposal.
